title: Add Tag Input
content: Create tag input component for entering multiple items. Container: flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-2 border rounded-lg focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500. Tags: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 rounded-full text-sm. Remove button: X icon w-4 h-4 hover:bg-blue-200 rounded-full. Input: flex-1 min-w-[120px] border-0 focus:ring-0 outline-none. Create tag on Enter or comma press. Remove last tag on Backspace when input empty. Prevent duplicates. Limit maximum tags optionally.

variants.simple: Create a tag/chip input for entering multiple values.
variants.detailed: Create tag input component for entering multiple items. Container: flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-2 border rounded-lg focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500. Tags: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 rounded-full text-sm. Remove button: X icon w-4 h-4 hover:bg-blue-200 rounded-full. Input: flex-1 min-w-[120px] border-0 focus:ring-0 outline-none. Create tag on Enter or comma press. Remove last tag on Backspace when input empty. Prevent duplicates. Limit maximum tags optionally.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive tag input with autocomplete support. Container: flex flex-wrap gap-2 p-2 min-h-[44px] border rounded-lg bg-white focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-blue-500 focus-within:border-blue-500 transition-shadow. Tags: inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-full text-sm font-medium. Tag with avatar: include small image/icon before text. Remove button: ml-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full hover:bg-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center, X icon or × character. Input: flex-1 min-w-[150px] bg-transparent border-0 outline-none text-sm placeholder:text-gray-400. Tag creation triggers: Enter key, comma key, Tab key (configurable), blur (optional). Validation: prevent duplicates (case-insensitive), maxTags limit with message, pattern validation (email tags, etc). Autocomplete/suggestions: absolute dropdown below input showing filtered options, keyboard navigation (arrows + enter), highlight matching text. Drag to reorder: enable drag-drop to reorder tags. Tag variants: default (filled), outline (border only), different colors per tag category. Paste handling: split pasted text by comma/newline into multiple tags. Accessibility: role="listbox" for suggestions, aria-selected, tags as list with role="list", remove buttons have aria-label="Remove [tag]". Props: value (string array), onChange, placeholder, maxTags, allowDuplicates, suggestions, onCreateTag, validateTag, disabled, delimiter. Component composition: TagInput.Root, TagInput.Tag, TagInput.Input for customization.
